root_idea.summary: The root centers on an inference formed from an indication, ranging from conjecture and doubt to a strongly held belief or certainty.
root_idea.development: Its semantic branches extend from thought and inference to suspicion, evil opinion, and states or places whose existence or reliability is only presumed. The contrast between certainty and doubt is fundamental, while related derivatives describe applying conjecture, being suspected, or serving as an indication of something.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Form I verb is a distinct Quranic lexical form.
The verbal noun and ordinary noun occurrences are presented under the citation form ظَنّ.
This Quranic active participle is presented under its normalized singular citation form ظَانّ.

senses.definition: To think, suppose, opine, or conjecture; to form a belief about something without full certainty.
senses.usage_conditions: The verb commonly denotes an inference or preponderant belief between doubt and certainty. With بِـ, it may make a person or thing the object of one's thought, whether favorably or unfavorably.

senses.definition: To know or be certain through reflection and inference rather than direct sensory perception.
senses.usage_conditions: This is a Quranic use in contexts where consideration has produced conviction; it is distinct from immediate ocular or sensory knowledge.

senses.definition: To suspect someone or think ill of someone; to entertain an unfavorable opinion.
senses.usage_conditions: The object is treated as the subject of a negative assumption or suspicion. The construction may express an evil opinion of a person or of God.

senses.definition: An inference, opinion, or supposition formed from an indication; an assumption whose strength may vary.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage, the noun often denotes an unsupported or non-certain assumption, while the broader lexical range allows an inference to be strongly held.

senses.definition: Suspicion or an unfavorable opinion; a bad assumption about someone or something.
senses.usage_conditions: This sense appears in constructions involving evil opinion, excessive suspicion, or an assumption opposed to the truth.

senses.definition: One who holds an opinion or assumption; in the Quranic occurrence, one who harbors an evil opinion of God.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural expression refers specifically to people entertaining a bad expectation or assumption about God.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Knowledge or certainty reached through consideration and inference rather than direct sensory perception.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal classical use distinguished from immediate or ocular knowledge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to think or suppose something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV causative usage; the caused thought is expressed as an object or complement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to be suspected or to expose someone to suspicion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV usage involving the social imputation or production of suspicion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The exercising or employing of conjecture and supposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V verbal noun; historically explained as arising from التَّظَنُّنُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Suspicion, an evil opinion, or a slight suspicion of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may denote the person or thing made the object of suspicion, as well as a small or tentative suspicion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who thinks evil of everyone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive personal description of habitual or pervasive evil opinion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person or thing in which little goodness, trust, or confidence is placed; especially a person expected to refuse what is requested.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The description may concern moral reliability, expected generosity, or general trustworthiness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A resource or obligation whose availability or fulfillment is uncertain, especially a well or water source of unknown supply, or a debt whose repayment is doubtful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to things whose existence, usefulness, or recovery cannot be relied upon.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person suspected in intellect, intelligence, lineage, or grounds for a claim to honor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A personal characterization of doubtful competence or doubtful grounds of social respect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A noble woman of advanced age taken in marriage in the hope of obtaining offspring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized classical usage describing the circumstances and purpose of the marriage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A weak man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A personal adjective referring to weakness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person of little artifice, ingenuity, cunning, or skill.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A personal description of limited practical ability or resourcefulness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Suspected or regarded as untrustworthy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a person whose truthfulness, reliability, or disclosed information is questioned.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Weak or lacking strength.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported alternative interpretation of the adjective in a Quranic reading; it is kept distinct from the sense of being suspected.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who treats another with enmity or hostility.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The hostile behavior is explained as associated with evil opinion and being an object of evil opinion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who frequently opines or conjectures, especially in an evil manner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive personal adjective describing recurrent and unfavorable conjecture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The person most likely to be thought capable of doing something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A superlative construction expressing greatest fitness as the object of an expectation or supposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place, circumstance, person, or indication in which something is thought or known to exist; a likely locus or sign of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to locations, people, qualities, and circumstances that occasion or support an inference about the existence of something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A report or narrative whose real status is doubtful or cannot be reliably ascertained.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to transmitted material whose truth or actual condition is not securely known.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In lexicology, a word belonging to the class called آحاد.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical classification of a lexical or transmitted item.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Covers thought, inferred certainty, and favorable or unfavorable opinion constructions.
Covers suspecting and thinking evil of someone.
Form IV causation or exposure of suspicion.
Covers nominal thought, suspicion, and reflective certainty.
The slight-suspicion extension is covered by the same meaning.
A person who thinks evil of everyone.
Person of little goodness or expected refusal.
Unreliability in persons, resources, wells, water, and debts.
Suspect status and the specialized marriage usage.
Suspected sense and reported weak interpretation.
Superlative fitness for being thought likely to act.
Likely locus, person, circumstance, or indication.
Doubtful report and technical lexical classification.

cautions: ظَنَّ ranges contextually from conjecture and suspicion to certainty reached by inference; these are lexical branches rather than merely translation variants.
The classical adjective ظَنِين in a Quranic citation has competing interpretations, including suspected and weak. It is not one of the supplied QAC form groups.
